metadata.title: Gritty Monochrome Portrait with Vertical Sidebar

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white portrait of a man in a dark jacket, positioned against a weathered wall and a vintage vehicle, featuring a distinct vertical tan-colored sidebar on the left containing large, stacked typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the organic, grainy photo and the flat, geometric sidebar
Vertical alignment of the primary text against the horizontal gaze of the subject
Tonal harmony between the tan sidebar and the dark sepia-tinted shadows
Juxtaposition of the subject's soft hair against the hard textures of the wall and car
coreInvariants: Vertical sidebar occupying approximately 15-20% of the left frame
Deep black shadows with preserved highlight detail on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is crouched in the lower right quadrant, medium-full shot, looking toward the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large vertical text on the left sidebar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large vertical text, move right to the subject's face, then down to the hands and cigarette.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark space in the center-right, balanced by the textured sidebar on the left.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Tan/Kraft paper brown for the sidebar
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark bronze/brown for the large display text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall; high value contrast between the subject's skin and dark clothing.

letterConstructionRules: Wide, square proportions for display text
Tight tracking for the vertical stack
High-contrast scale between primary and secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical rotation of 90 degrees clockwise for the primary name

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: One word per line, stacked vertically

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme scale contrast between a heavy, wide display face and a light, tracked-out secondary face.
graphicDevices: Hard edge boundary between sidebar and photo

preserve: Tan/Brown color palette for text elements

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and wide stance for the display text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura Light or Gill Sans Light
candidateDirections.reason: Offers the clean, airy feel required for the tracked-out subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy black and white photo of a man in a black jacket crouched next to a vintage car and a textured concrete wall. Add a solid tan vertical bar on the far left side covering 20% of the width.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, wide sans-serif text in dark bronze, rotated 90 degrees clockwise and stacked vertically inside the tan bar. Add a small, light, white sans-serif subtitle with wide letter spacing horizontally across the center-left, bridging the bar and the photo.

verificationChecks: Is the sidebar color a muted tan/kraft paper tone?
Is the main text rotated 90 degrees and stacked?
Is the photo high-contrast with visible film grain?
Does the subtitle have significant letter spacing?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the tan/bronze palette
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that text is not mirrored or garbled
Ensure the vertical text is rotated correctly
Verify the grain texture is consistent across the photo area
Confirm the sidebar edge is sharp and straight
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a gritty monochrome portrait with a 20% width textured color sidebar; use wide, bold, rotated sans-serif type in the sidebar and thin, tracked-out horizontal type as a bridge element.
